policies.shipping:
We deliver across the United Arab Emirates.

Delivery fees
Dubai: AED 15. Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah: AED 25. The fee for your emirate is shown at checkout before you place your order.

Prices and VAT
All prices are in UAE dirhams (AED) and include 5% VAT. The VAT amount is shown in your order summary.

Payment
Pay online by card (Ziina) or choose cash on delivery and pay the courier the exact total shown at checkout.

Courier and tracking
Orders are delivered by our courier partner, iMile. Once your order is handed to the courier you can follow it on the Track order page using your order number and the email you used at checkout, or ask our AI assistant.

Delivery times
Delivery times are estimates and start when your order is handed to the courier. They can be affected by courier delays, public holidays, weather or other events outside our control.

Address and receiving your order
Please check your address and phone number at checkout so the courier can reach you. If a delivery fails because the address was wrong or the parcel was refused, we may need to charge the delivery fee again to resend it.

Damaged, lost or wrong items
Check your parcel when it arrives. If anything is damaged, missing or wrong, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo and we will make it right.

Changes and cancellations
You can cancel an unpaid order yourself while its status is Received (ask our AI assistant). For any other change, contact us as soon as possible. Once an order is with the courier it can no longer be changed.

Questions? Email yahia.h2026@hotmail.com or call / WhatsApp +971 52 586 6612.
policies.returns:
Returns and exchanges
You can return or exchange items within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed and undamaged, with their original tags and packaging.

Size exchanges
Ordered the wrong size? Contact us within 7 days of delivery and we will exchange it for another size, subject to stock.

How to start a return
Message our AI assistant on the website: RETURN followed by your order number and the reason (for example: RETURN YH-1001 too small), or contact us by email or WhatsApp. Please wait for our reply before sending anything back; we will tell you how to return the item.

Return delivery costs
If an item arrives faulty or damaged, or we sent the wrong item, we cover the return delivery and replace it or refund you in full. For change-of-mind returns and exchanges, the return delivery cost is paid by you.

Items we cannot accept
Items that have been worn, washed, altered or damaged after delivery, or returned without their tags.

Refunds
We inspect returned items as soon as they arrive. Approved refunds are made to your original payment method: card payments back to the same card; cash-on-delivery orders by bank transfer to an account in your name. Delivery fees are refunded only when the item was faulty or wrong. Your bank may need a few extra days to show the refund.

Your rights
This policy does not affect your rights under UAE consumer protection law.

Contact
Email yahia.h2026@hotmail.com or call / WhatsApp +971 52 586 6612.
